title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant
Redditch
Full Time
£28,000 - £35,000p/a dep on experience

Are you looking to build your career in finance within a supportive and growing business? We're looking for an organised and motivated Accounts Assistant to join our clients finance team in Redditch.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers, takes pride in accuracy, and wants to develop their finance skills in a collaborative environment. Whether you're already gaining experience in accounts or are looking to further your professional development, you'll be supported by an experienced team and given exposure to a broad range of finance responsibilities.

The Opportunity
As an Accounts Assistant, you'll play an important role in supporting the day to day finance function, ensuring financial records are maintained accurately, and key processes are completed efficiently. You'll gain exposure to multiple areas of finance and have the opportunity to expand your knowledge while contributing to the success of the wider team.

Key Responsibilities
- Complete multi currency bank reconciliations accurately and on time
- Support month end processes, including prepayments, accruals, expenses, and fixed asset reconciliations
- Assist with cash posting and generate sales invoices when required
- Process invoices, expenses, and payments for the Group PLC entity
- Maintain accurate financial records across all ledgers
- Support credit control activities and professionally handle supplier queries
- Assist with finance reporting, administrative tasks, and ad hoc projects

About You
We're looking for someone who is naturally organised, detail oriented, and confident working with financial information. You'll enjoy working as part of a team while taking ownership of your own responsibilities.
You'll ideally have:
- Strong Excel skills, including formulas and data manipulation
- Good numeracy skills and confidence working with financial data
- The ability to learn new systems and digital tools quickly
- Excellent communication skills and confidence managing queries
- A proactive approach with a willingness to learn and develop
- A flexible, team-focused attitude, particularly around month-end deadlines

Desirable
- A finance-related degree or equivalent qualification
- Studying towards a professional finance qualification

What's in It for You?
A comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, financial future, and work-life balance:
26 days holiday plus bank holidays
Annual discretionary bonus
Cycle to Work Scheme
Electric Vehicle Salary Sacrifice Scheme

Why Apply?
This is a fantastic opportunity to join a business that values development, teamwork, and progression. You'll gain valuable exposure across a busy finance function while working in an environment that encourages learning, continuous improvement, and career growth.

If you're looking for a role where you can develop your finance career and make a real contribution, we'd love to hear from you.

For more information on this position, please contact Harriet Ali at Four Squared Recruitment.

If you have not heard from us within three weeks of submitting your application, please assume that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion. We thank you for your interest and encourage you to apply for future opportunities.

title: Payroll Assistant
description:
As a Payroll Assistant in Worcestershire, you will help keep payroll activity organised within the Accounting & Finance department for an Industrial / Manufacturing employer. You will provide practical payroll cover during a temporary assignment, helping day-to-day processes run smoothly.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Industrial / Manufacturing sector in Worcestershire.

Description

The Payroll Assistant will;
- Process payroll information accurately to support timely payment activity.
- Check payroll records and resolve straightforward data queries before processing.
- Maintain clear payroll documentation so information is easy to review.
- Update payroll data accurately within relevant systems and records.
- Work with the Accounting & Finance department to provide payroll information when needed.
- Handle payroll-related queries in a clear and professional manner.
- Support the preparation of payroll data for regular processing cycles.
- Keep payroll information organised throughout the temporary assignment.

Profile

A successful 'Payroll Assistant' should have:
- Practical ability to process and maintain payroll information accurately.
- Confidence checking data and spotting discrepancies in payroll records.
- Experience updating payroll details within systems or spreadsheets.
- Ability to manage payroll queries clearly and professionally.
- Good attention to detail when handling numerical information.
- Ability to keep records organised during a busy payroll cycle.

Job Offer
- Temporary Payroll Assistant assignment in Worcestershire.
- Hourly pay of £15 to £19, dependent on the level of experience.
- Fully office based
- Full time or part time hours
- Potential to be permanent

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Service Administrator
company: Rise Technical Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Service Administrator

£30,000-£32,000 + Training + Bonus + Excellent Company Benefits + Career Progression

Kidderminster (Commutable from: Stourport-on-Severn, Bewdley, Bromsgrove, Worcester, Droitwich Spa, Redditch, Dudley, Stourbridge, Halesowen and surrounding areas)

Are you a Service Coordinator or Service Administrator with an interest in engineering, looking to join an established business offering long-term stability, training and career progression?

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing engineering business where you will play a key role in coordinating service engineers, managing customer requirements and ensuring service operations run efficiently.

The company has built a strong reputation within its industry and offers a supportive working environment where employees are valued and encouraged to develop. With a varied workload and opportunities to expand your technical knowledge, this is an ideal opportunity to build a long-term career within engineering.

In this role, you will coordinate engineers carrying out service, maintenance and repair work at customer sites. You will manage schedules, arrange site visits, liaise with customers and engineers, and ensure jobs are completed efficiently. Working closely with the wider service team, you will help resolve scheduling issues and maintain a high standard of customer service.

This role would suit someone with experience in service coordination, engineering administration or scheduling who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment. Candidates from other coordination or administrative backgrounds will also be considered if they have strong organisational skills and an interest in engineering.

The Role:
- Coordinate and schedule field service engineers for maintenance, repairs and breakdowns.
- Arrange customer site visits, ensuring engineers have the information and resources required.
- Liaise with engineers, customers and internal departments to manage workloads and priorities.
- Monitor ongoing jobs, track progress and provide customers with updates.
- Assist with ordering parts and coordinating equipment required for service visits.
- Maintain accurate service records, job sheets and internal systems.

The Person:
- Experience in service coordination, engineering administration, scheduling or a similar role.
- Strong organisational and communication skills.
- Comfortable managing multiple priorities and adapting to changing schedules.
- Confident using computer systems and Microsoft Office.
- A proactive approach with an interest in engineering and technical services.

Reference: BBBH281704
To apply for this role or to be considered for further roles, please click "Apply Now" or contact Tom at Rise Technical Recruitment.

Rise Technical Recruitment Ltd acts an employment agency for permanent roles and an employment business for temporary roles.

The salary advertised is the bracket available for this position. The actual salary paid will be dependent on your level of experience, qualifications and skill set and will be decided by our client, the employer. Rise are not responsible or liable for any hiring decisions made by the end client.

We are an equal opportunities company and welcome applications from all suitable candidates.

title: Administration Assistant
company: Herefordshire and Worcestershire Health and Care NHS Trust
advertiser_name: Herefordshire and Worcestershire Health and Care NHS Trust
description: The Podiatry Service at The John Anthony Centre is seeking a skilled, well-motivated Administrative Assistant to join our friendly and dedicated administrative team. This is a 30 hour post, though part-time hours will be considered for the right candidate, with a minimum of 25 hours. You will work closely with--and be fully supported by--our experienced administrator within a well-established service based at Kidderminster Health Centre. We are looking for an individual who is self-driven, reliable, and able to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. Strong communication skills and a positive, proactive approach are essential. You will receive full Trust and Service Induction, along with ongoing guidance and supervision from our existing team to help you settle into the role and develop confidently. We are committed to supporting flexible working and are happy to discuss working patterns that meet individual needs while ensuring the smooth running of the service Applicants must read the attached guidance notes before submitting your application for full understanding of Trust requirements. A role in our team offers a welcoming, supportive environment where your contribution truly matters. Each day brings variety and purpose: you'll handle and organise incoming and outgoing mail, respond to emails promptly, speak with patients, carers and colleagues over the phone, process referrals, book appointments for the clinical team, arrange home visits, maintain supplies, and carry out a range of general administrative tasks that keep the service running smoothly. You'll be based in a friendly office setting, working closely with our podiatrists to ensure their clinical day flows effortlessly. From coordinating referrals and appointments to providing practical support throughout the day, you'll play a key part in helping them deliver excellent patient care. Although you'll work independently, you'll always have guidance from the senior administrator and strong connections with the wider admin team across community podiatry. It's a place where people look out for one another, share knowledge, and collaborate to make the service the best it can be. Undertake administrative duties specific to the role eg typing standard keyboard skills required, data inputting, filing, scanning, referral processing, adding appointments to clinicians diaries and home visits. Add new patient spells and referral on the system in a timely manner. Answer and deal with telephone enquiries in a professional manner seeking guidance as required, recording details accurately and forwarding to the relevant member of the team in a timely manner Process incoming and outgoing mail Order and maintain stock supplies Prepare for and attend appraisal meetings and participate in any relevant training programmes required by the Trust For full details of the duties and criteria for the role please refer to the job description and person specification attached.

description: An exciting opportunity has arisen within Herefordshire and Worcestershire's developing Children and Young People's Neurodevelopmental (ND) Service. The service focuses on the assessment and management of ADHD using a trauma-informed, developmental approach, supported by experienced Advanced Clinical Practitioners (ACPs) and Medical Consultants. We are seeking motivated and organised administrators to join our growing team. The successful candidates will work 22.5 hours per week and will be based at one of our locality offices in either Herefordshire or Worcestershire, with the base location to be agreed upon appointment. The service operates Monday to Friday, and we actively encourage flexible working. The 22.5 contracted hours can be worked flexibly within normal office hours to suit both service needs and the successful candidate where possible. Applicants must read the attached guidance notes before submitting your application for full understanding of Trust requirements. Services for Children with ASD and ADHD are undergoing exciting transformation in Herefordshire and Worcestershire. As an Administrator for the Neurodevelopmental Service you will provide an efficient and smooth running administration service for clinicians working in the team. You will maintain a team caseload spreadsheet (a high level of excel skill is required) and appointment system for clinics and make arrangements for patients/ relatives. Handle telephone enquiries regarding appointments, cancellations referring where necessary to the appropriate person. You will type and process clinic letters and make entries in the Electronic Patient Record. The ability to use your initiative, work proactively, demonstrate excellent communication and influencing skills, manage and prioritise your own workload and respond flexibly to changing demands are essential requirements of the role. We are a supportive and passionate team, and you will receive full training to ensure you can succeed in this role. For full details of the duties and criteria for the role please refer to the job description and person specification attached.
